instruction: Repair {{symbol}} in {{entry}} using the standard library. Cache JSON {savedAt:number,value:JSON} at path. Return a cached value only when savedAt is finite, 0 <= now-savedAt < ttl and ttl is positive; otherwise compute exactly once. Compute/serialization failures leave the old bytes and permissions intact. On refresh write a same-directory private temporary file, flush/fsync, atomically replace, preserve an existing regular file's permission bits (new files are 0600), and clean temporary files after any failure. Invalid/missing cache content is a miss. Reject symlink cache targets. Do not swallow compute/replace failures.
